record.one_liner: Payments and billing API for accepting payments, subscriptions and payouts online.
record.auth_notes: Secret and restricted API keys (sk_/rk_) from the Dashboard; OAuth for Connect (Standard accounts) and for the MCP server. critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: Sandboxes with test keys are created in the Dashboard without a paid plan. critic: confirmed against docs.stripe.com/keys.
record.api_notes: Resource-oriented REST API with form-encoded requests and JSON responses. Some v2 endpoints exist alongside v1.
record.blocker_notes: critic: confirmed; no gating on sandbox keys.
